source_text: Manus testium primi; lapidabit eum omnis populus. Testimonium grave. Veritas non otiosa.
pass_a_gloss: Hands of-witnesses first; will-stone him all people. Testimony heavy. Truth not idle.
pass_b_english: [[Witnesses’ hands first; all the people stone him >> Bible:Leviticus 24:14]]. Testimony is heavy. Truth is not idle.
